setTheme toggles away-and-back before flipping when a fresh context already sits in the target theme without a stored rnr-theme value, so the localStorage retention witness is always earned by real control clicks rather than the pre-paint default (tests/sprint-05-orient-search/recovery-presentation.spec.ts:328).
concerns: ORI-AST-009's not-found-search-recovery.spec.ts is broken on current main independent of this task: 2/13 fail (chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile, locked 8-step sequence and AC-3) with a strict-mode violation because '[data-search-slot] button' resolves to both the header trigger and the dialog's close button; any FLOW-SHELL-16 gate replay stays red until a FIX task lands the one-line selector pin.

The committed matrix exits 1 by design until the deployment owner publishes the reviewed candidate: ac-5 fails as an unmet public prerequisite on all three projects, so pipelines that run the whole spec file will see those three failures (public-unknown-path.png on main truthfully documents the empty-body public 404, not the branded surface).
evidence/recovery/runs/ accumulates one directory per playback (eight committed at landing); nothing prunes old runs, so the evidence tree grows with every matrix replay.

Port 4321 arbitration between active sibling worktrees remains a live race: leaked astro previews are PPID-1 orphans indistinguishable from an in-flight run's webServer without checking for active playwright processes first, and my cycle both killed a genuine leak and mistakenly killed one server under an active sibling run (no work was lost; the sibling's gates had already passed).
findings: The pre-fix 404 rendered the approved explanation twice in the emitted dist (verified: 2 occurrences in dist/404.html) because ORI-AST-009's spec pinned .page-header__description byte-equal but never asserted the manuscript text renders exactly once — presentation specs should assert copy uniqueness, not just presence.

ORI-VIS-003's merge 90cbe643 added data-search-close inside the [data-search-slot] mount (SearchDialog.astro:55), silently breaking ORI-AST-009's '[data-search-slot] button' selector while search-presentation.spec.ts's own 'button.search-dialog__trigger' pin stayed safe — cross-task selectors must target the element's own class, not a descendant-of-container shape.

A fresh browser context starts in the pre-paint default theme with localStorage rnr-theme unset, so a theme-persistence witness that only checks the class when already flipped polls null forever; the control must be made to write storage by real clicks.

Single-column geometry oracles must compare sibling regions to each other, not children against the container's border box: main.not-found's 1.5rem padding offsets every child by 24px and fails a 2px tolerance against the container's own x.

This repo's Playwright typings expose neither Locator.allBoundingBoxes nor expect.fail — use an nth(i).boundingBox() loop (protocol-level, works with JavaScript disabled) and a thrown Error for prerequisite failures.

feedback: The ac-5 pattern — run the probe for real, capture the actual public state, then fail loudly as an unmet prerequisite with the owner named — kept the deployment dependency honest without a skip or a fake pass; it should be the standing template for deployment-dependent ACs.

Tasks whose predecessors pin exact DOM oracles (byte-equal text, region classes) should surface those pins in the dependency handoff's consumable form; I had to read ORI-AST-009's full spec to learn the explanation was already pinned to .page-header__description, which decided the whole composition.
